GOVERNEMNT OF KARNATAKA

RD 88 PFH 2022 Karnataka Government Secretariat
Multi Storied Building
Bengaluru, Date:13-03-2023

FINAL NOTIFICATION

Whereas the draft of the Notification No.RD 88 PFH 2022, Dated:21-6-2022
regarding altering the limits of Karadaga village of Nippani Taluk and Belagavi
District and constituting a new revenue village called Donewadi was published as
required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12
of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No. RD 88 PFH 2022, Dated:01-08-2022 inviting
objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be affected thereby within
thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official Gazette.

And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:24-11-2022 And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and
considered by the State Government;

Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE-1

Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village of Karadaga taluk Nippani in Belagavi District to form a new revenue village
called of Donewadi taluk Nippani in Belagavi district along with survey numbers
included in column (4) thereof.

GOVERNEMNT OF KARNATAKA

RD 90 PFH 2022 Karnataka Government Secretariat
Multi Storied Building
Bengaluru, Date:14-03-2023

FINAL NOTIFICATION

Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 90 PFH 2022
Dated:21-06-2022 regarding altering the limits of Nanadi village of Chikkodi Taluk
and Belagavi District and constituting a new revenue village called Nanadiwadi was
published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964
(Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No. RD 90 PFH
2022 Dated:01-08-2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely
to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official
Gazette.

And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:30-01-2023 And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and
considered by the State Government;

Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE-1

Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village of Nanadi taluk Chikkodi in Belagavi District to form a new revenue village
called of Nanadiwadi taluk Chikkodi in Belagavi district along with survey numbers
included in column (4) thereof.

GOVERNEMNT OF KARNATAKA

RD 93 PFH 2022 Karnataka Government Secretariat
Multi Storied Building
Bengaluru, Date:14-03-2023

FINAL NOTIFICATION

Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 93 PFH 2022
Dated:20-06-2022 regarding altering the limits of Nayinglaja village of Chikkodi
Taluk and Belagavi District and constituting a new revenue village called
Dhulaganwadi and Yadyanwadi was published as required by section 6 of the
Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka
Gazette No. RD 93 PFH 2022 Dated:01-08-2022 inviting objections or suggestions
from all the persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its
publication in the Official Gazette.

And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:30-01-2023 And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and
considered by the State Government;

Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE-1

Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village of Nayinglaja taluk Chikkodi in Belagavi District to form a new revenue
village called of Dhulaganwadi taluk Chikkodi in Belagavi district along with

GOVERNMENT OF KARNATAKA
RD 34 PFH 2023 Karnataka Government Secretariat
Multi Storied Building
Bengaluru, Date:13-03-2023
PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act, 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the factors
specified in clauses (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966
such as the population, area of the village the demand under land revenue in the village
and other head of account and having regard to the administrative convenience the
Government of Karnataka proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of
Rudrapur Village of Saudatti Taluk, Belagavi District and to constitute a new
village called Girinagar as specified in schedule along with maps with old survey
numbers and new survey numbers assigned to them.
Now therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state Government
from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date specified above will
be considered by the state Government. Objections or suggestion may be addressed to
the Deputy Commissioner Belagavi, District Belagavi.

SCHEDULE-1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village Rudrapur of Saudatti Taluk in Belagavi District to form a new revenue
village called as Girinagar of Saudatti taluk and Belagavi district along with the
survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

and other head of account and having regard to the administrative convenience the
Government of Karnataka proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of Tallur
Village of Saudatti Taluk, Belagavi District and to constitute a new village called
Somapur as specified in schedule along with maps with old survey numbers and new
survey numbers assigned to them.
Now therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state Government
from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date specified above will
be considered by the state Government. Objections or suggestion may be addressed to
the Deputy Commissioner Belagavi, District Belagavi.
SCHEDULE-1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village Tallur of Saudatti Taluk in Belagavi District to form a new revenue village
called as Somapur of Saudatti taluk and Belagavi district along with the survey
numbers included in column (4) thereof.

GOVERNEMNT OF KARNATAKA

RD 128 PFH 2022 Karnataka Government Secretariat
Multi Storied Building
Bengaluru, Date:14-03-2023

FINAL NOTIFICATION

Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 128 PFH 2022
Dated:27-06-2022 regarding altering the limits of Uchagaon village of Belagavi
Taluk and Belagavi District and constituting a new revenue village called
Konewadi and Basurte was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No.
RD 128 PFH 2022 Dated:02-08-2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the
persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication
in the Official Gazette.

And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:27-11-2022 And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and
considered by the State Government;

Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE-1

Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village of Uchagaon taluk Belagavi in Belagavi District to form a new revenue
village called of Konewadi taluk Belagavi in Belagavi district along with survey
numbers included in column (4) thereof.

PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act, 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the factors
specified in clauses (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966
such as the population, area of the village the demand under land revenue in the village
and other head of account and having regard to the administrative convenience the
Government of Karnataka proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of
Ugargol Village of Saudatti Taluk, Belagavi District and to constitute a new village
called Yallamma Tanda as specified in schedule along with maps with old survey
numbers and new survey numbers assigned to them.
Now therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state Government
from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date specified above will
be considered by the state Government. Objections or suggestion may be addressed to
the Deputy Commissioner Belagavi, District Belagavi.
SCHEDULE-1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village Ugargol of Saudatti Taluk in Belagavi District to form a new revenue village
called as Yallamma Tanda of Saudatti taluk and Belagavi district along with the
survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

GOVERNMENT OF KARNATAKA
RD 29 PFH 2023 Karnataka Government Secretariat
Multi Storied Building
Bengaluru, Date:13-03-2023
PRELIMINARY NOTIFICATION
In exercise of the powers conferred by Section 5 of the Karnataka Land Revenue
Act, 1964 (Karnataka act no 12 of 1964) and taking into consideration the factors
specified in clauses (i) to (iv) of rule 3 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Rules 1966
such as the population, area of the village the demand under land revenue in the village
and other head of account and having regard to the administrative convenience the
Government of Karnataka proposes to issue a Notification to alter the limits of
Karlakatti Village of Saudatti Taluk, Belagavi District and to constitute a new
village called Venkateshnagar as specified in schedule along with maps with old
survey numbers and new survey numbers assigned to them.
Now therefore in exercise of the power conferred by section 6 of the said Act,
notice is hereby given for the information of all the persons likely to be affected
thereby that the proposal will be taken into consideration on or after thirty days from
the date of publication of the notification in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state Government
from any person with respect to the said proposal before the date specified above will
be considered by the state Government. Objections or suggestion may be addressed to
the Deputy Commissioner Belagavi, District Belagavi.
SCHEDULE-1
Lands bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village Karlakatti of Saudatti Taluk in Belagavi District to form a new revenue
village called as Venkateshnagar of Saudatti taluk and Belagavi district along with
the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

RD 85 PFH 2022 Karnataka Government Secretariat
Multi Storied Building
Bengaluru, Date:14-03-2023

FINAL NOTIFICATION

Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 85 PFH 2022
Dated:20-06-2022 regarding altering the limits of Vijaynagar village of Chikkodi
Taluk and Belagavi District and constituting a new revenue village called
Pogatyanahatti was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No.
RD 85 PFH 2022 Dated:02-08-2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the
persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication
in the Official Gazette.

And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:30-01-2023 And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and
considered by the State Government;

Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
here by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE-1

Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village of Vijaynagar taluk Chikkodi in Belagavi District to form a new revenue
village called of Pogatyanahatti taluk Chikkodi in Belagavi district along with
survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

GOVERNEMNT OF KARNATAKA

RD 148 GLH 2022 Karnataka Government Secretariat
Multi Storied Building
Bengaluru, Date: 08 -03-2023

FINAL NOTIFICATION

Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 148 GLH 2022
Dated:02-02-2023 regarding altering the limits of Bankanakatte village of
Ajjampura Taluk in Chickmagalore District and constituting a new revenue village
called M Hosahalli, was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karnataka Gazette No.
RD 148 GLH 2022 Dated:03-02-2023 inviting objections or suggestions from all the
persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication
in the Official Gazette.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:03-02-2023 And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and
considered by the State Government;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka here
by makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE-1

Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village Bankanakatte of Ajjampura Taluk and Chickmagalore District to form a
new revenue village called M Hosahalli, Ajjampura Taluk in Chickmagalore district
along with survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 190 PFH 2022 Dated:19-08-2022
regarding altering the limits of Chikkarasinakere village of Maddur Taluk and
Mandya District and constituting a new revenue village called Guudevarahalli was
published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964
(Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karanataka Gazette No. RD 190 PFH 2022
dated:25-08-2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the persons likely to be
affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication in the Official
Gazette.

And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:-26-09-2022

And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and considered by
the State Government;

Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka here
by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE-1

Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village of Maddur taluk in Mandya District to form a new revenue village called
Guudevarahalli of Maddur taluk Mandya district along with survey numbers
included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 157 GLH 2022
Dated:19-08-2022 regarding altering the limits of Gejjalgere village of Maddur
Taluk and Mandya District and constituting a new revenue village called
Gejjalgerecolony was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karanataka Gazette No.
RD 157 GLH 2022 dated:25-08-2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the
persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication
in the Official Gazette.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on Dated:-26-09-
And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and considered by
the State Government;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka here
by makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE-1

Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village of Maddur taluk in Mandya District to form a new revenue village called
Gejjalgerecolony of Maddur taluk Mandya district along with survey numbers
included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No RD 07 GLH 2022,
Dated:19/01/2022 regarding altering the limits of Kadalaveni village of
Gowribidanur Taluk, Chikkaballapura District and constituting a new revenue
village called Channenahalli was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karanataka Gazette No.
RD 07 GLH 2022 Dated:20/04/2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the
persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication
in the Official Gazette.
And Whereas, the said Gazette was made available to the public on
Date:13/05/2022 and Whereas, no objections and suggestions are received.
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
hereby makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE-1
Land bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village of Gowribidanur taluk in Chikkaballapur District to form a new revenue
village called as Channenahalli of Gowribidanur taluk, Chikkaballapur district
along with the survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION

Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 159 GLH 2022
Dated:19-08-2022 regarding altering the limits of Karadakere village of Maddur
Taluk and Mandya District and constituting a new revenue village called
Hanumanthanagara was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karanataka Gazette No.
RD 159 GLH 2022 Dated:26-08-2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the
persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication
in the Official Gazette.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:-27-09-2022
And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and considered by
the State Government;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka here
by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE-1

Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village of Maddur taluk in Mandya District to form a new revenue village called
Hanumanthanagara of Maddur taluk Mandya district along with survey numbers
included in column (4) thereof.

GOVERNEMNT OF KARNATAKA

RD 192 PFH 2022 Karnataka Government Secretariat
Multi Storied Building
Bengaluru, Date:08-03-2023

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No. RD 192 PFH 2022
Dated:19-08-2022 regarding altering the limits of Kowdley village of Maddur
Taluk and Mandya District and constituting a new revenue village called
Tharamanakatte & Ghattahalli was published as required by section 6 of the
Karnataka Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karanataka
Gazette No. RD 192 PFH 2022 Dated:26-08-2022 inviting objections or suggestions
from all the persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its
publication in the Official Gazette.
And whereas, the said gazette was made available to the public on
Dated:-27-09-2022
And whereas, objections and suggestions have been received and considered by
the State Government;
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka here
by makes the following notification, namely:-

SCHEDULE-1

Land bearing survey numbers of the village and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village of Maddur taluk in Mandya District to form a new revenue village called
Tharamanakatte of Maddur taluk Mandya district along with survey numbers
included in column (4) thereof.

FINAL NOTIFICATION
Whereas the draft of the Notification No RD 87 GLH 2022,
Dated: 05/07/2022 regarding altering the limits of Maddalakahane village of
Bagepalli Taluk, Chikkaballapura District and constituting a new revenue village
called Guntiganahalli was published as required by section 6 of the Karnataka Land
Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) in the Karanataka Gazette No.
RD 87 GLH 2022 Dated: 25/07/2022 inviting objections or suggestions from all the
persons likely to be affected thereby within thirty days from the date of its publication
in the Official Gazette.
And Whereas, the said Gazette was made available to the public on
Date:10/08/2022 and Whereas, no objections and suggestions are received.
Now, therefore, in exercise of the powers conferred by section 5 of Karnataka
Land Revenue Act, 1964 (Karnataka act No.12 of 1964) the Government of Karnataka
hereby makes the following notification, namely:-
SCHEDULE-1
Land bearing survey numbers of the villages and survey numbers of the areas
specified in column (2) of the table below shall be excluded from the limits of said
village of Bagepalli taluk in Chikkaballapur District to form a new revenue village
called as Guntiganahalli of Bagepalli taluk, Chikkaballapur district along with the
survey numbers included in column (4) thereof.

NOTIFICATION
The draft of the following rules further to amend the Bruhat Bengaluru
Mahanagara Palike (General Cadre and Recruitment of Officers and Employees)
Rules, 2020, which the Government of Karnataka proposes to make in exercise of the
powers conferred by section 316 of the Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike Act,
2020 (Karnataka Act 53 of 2020), is hereby published as required by sub-section (1) of
the said section, for the information of all persons likely to be affected thereby and
notice is hereby given that the said draft will be taken into consideration after fifteen
days from the date of its publication in the official Gazette.
Any objection or suggestion which may be received by the state Government
from any person with respect to the said draft before the expiry of the period specified
above will be considered by the State Government. Objections and suggestions may be
addressed to the Additional Chief Secretary to Government, Urban Development
Department, Vikasa Soudha, Bengaluru – 560 001.
DRAFT RULES
1. Title and commencement.- (1) These rules may be called the Bruhat Bengaluru
Mahanagara Palike (General Cadre and Recruitment of Officers and Employees)
(Amendment) Rules, 2022.
(2) They shall come into force from the date of their final publication in the
official Gazette.
2. Amendment of Schedule-I.- In the Bruhat Bengaluru Mahanagara Palike
(General Cadre and Recruitment of Officers and Employees) Rules, 2020, (hereinafter
referred to as the said rules), in Schedule-I, under Horticulture Department, at serial
number 06, in the category of post of “Head Gardner/Horticulture Maistry/ Decorative
Maistry (Maistries) (Rs.18600-32600)”, under the heading “Minimum qualification” in
column (5), the clause (2) and the entries relating thereto shall be omitted.
3. Amendment of Schedule-III.- In the said rules, in Schedule-III, the serial
numbers 100 and 101, and the entries relating thereto shall be omitted.

By Order and in the name of the
Governor of Karnataka
(Lakshmisagar N.K)
Under Secretary to Govt
Urban Development Department (BBMP)
